method: ELF static disassembly, relocation resolution and registered property name decoding

rules.note: ID range check, independent of the user's inventory

rules.condition: runtimeField_0x3d8 initialized to zero, set to one if virtual_char_id at 0x15c is nonzero

limits: Library mask conditions do not prove a character has never appeared before or will be released in the future.
Quest future timestamps and test_flag are displayed as source values; a missing event reference is not an unreleased-content proof.
Image name hashes can collide; decoded PNG contents and known alternate references are shown separately.
